candidate_ideas.statement: On a smooth tetragonal curve of genus 6 with tetragonal divisor class D, the Casnati–Ekedahl bundle satisfies W_5≅ω_C^{⊗2}(-D) and W_4≅ω_C^{⊗2}.
From the relative dualizing sheaf identities ω_{C/P^1}≅O_{P(E^∨)}(1)|_C≅ω_C⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(2) one obtains O_{P(E^∨)}(2)|_C≅ω_C^{⊗2}⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(4), and hence W_f≅ω_C^{⊗2}⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(4-f).
For every degree-6 divisor Γ, deg(ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=-4, so H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0 universally.
For a degree-6 divisor Γ, deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0 and H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))≠0 if and only if O_C(Γ)≅ω_C(-D)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}.
By vanishing of the f=4 obstruction, the Casnati–Ekedahl evaluation map drops rank if and only if the f=5 obstruction space is nonzero.

Over the moduli of balanced tetragonal genus-6 curves, the evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal} is the relative incidence scheme of divisors Γ with O_C(Γ)≅ω_C(-D), i.e. the relative linear system |ω_C(-D)|≅|W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}|.
For a general tetragonal curve with h^0(C,D)=2, Riemann–Roch and Serre duality give h^0(C,ω_C(-D))=3, so |ω_C(-D)| is a projective plane.

The balanced tetragonal Hurwitz space of genus 6 has dimension 15 (18 simple branch points, modulo Aut(P^1)), and the relative linear system contributes fibre dimension 2, yielding dim Z^{bal}=17 and codimension 4 inside M_{6,6} (dimension 21).
The ordered distinct reduced six-point locus Z^{ord,red} is a smooth 17-dimensional stack and is a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in the relative linear system.

Over the moduli stack of genus-6 balanced tetragonal curves with six ordered marked points, Z is canonically isomorphic to the relative incidence scheme of the degree-6 linear system |W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}|≅|ω_C(-D)| of projective dimension 2.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The equality h^0(C,ω_C(-D))=3 is obtained only under the hypothesis h^0(C,D)=2. On loci where h^0(D) jumps, Riemann–Roch forces h^0(ω_C(-D)) to jump as well, so the incidence space is not a P^2-bundle of constant relative dimension 2 over the whole base.
invalid_steps.statement: The relative linear system |ω_C(-D)| is a relative P^2-bundle over the entire 15-dimensional balanced tetragonal Hurwitz space.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Riemann–Hurwitz supplies only the total ramification degree deg R=2g-2+2d. The equality between that degree and the number of branch points, and hence the dimension count b-3, holds only when every ramification point is simple; without that restriction the branch-point count and the moduli dimension need not equal 18 and 15.
invalid_steps.statement: The ramification count b=2g-2+2d is used as the number of branch points to conclude dim H_6^{tet,bal}=b-3=15 without a simple-branching hypothesis.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Dimension of the incidence variety does not imply smoothness of the stack or of its ordered reduced open; étale-local regular parameters, or an equivalent transversality/regularity argument for the incidence condition O_C(Γ)≅ω_C(-D), are required.
invalid_steps.statement: Smoothness of the ordered reduced evaluation-failure locus as a 17-dimensional stack in M_{6,6} is deduced from the dimension count alone.
